plan: My value is $10. Next price is $10, meaning staying in would give zero profit if I win at that price, and negative profit if price rises further. No incentive to continue since expected value is not positive.

At price $30.0, staying in would mean paying at least my value ($30), resulting in zero or negative profit. Since price is about to exceed my value, continuing offers no upside. I should drop out now to avoid a loss.
Price is nearing my value of $25. Staying in means paying at least $25 next, which equals my value (zero profit) or more (loss) if others continue. No upside to continue.
